(1.5); travelKm? (13); pitchFromNadir? (76); verticalExaggeration? (1.1); maximumScreenSpaceError? (8). Env: REMOTION_MAPTILER_KEY (landscape) / REMOTION_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (city).
